items.text: We're thrilled to announce the latest patch for Hunt the Night, packed with exciting changes and improvements. Here's a rundown of what you can expect:

Prime Hunt Mode is now unlocked! Battle against final bosses with new attacks and increased difficulty in a mode where your time will be recorded. Plan and create your build before the fight and prepare for a truly deadly gaming experience. Don't forget to share your times with the community!
Each boss will be unlocked once you defeat them in the normal game mode.
We are pleased to announce our first three collaborations with other indie games, including three completely new bosses from other games adapted to Hunt the Night. In this first pack, you'll find:
Red Camerlengo from The Count Lucanor.
Ice Queen from Lost Ruins.
The Watcher from Bug Fables.: We hope you enjoy these three entirely new battles and take a look at these three games if you haven't already!
Save System Reimplementation
Experience a revamped save system for smoother progress tracking.
Backup System
Introducing a backup feature to ensure your heroic exploits are always secured.
Persistent Shops
Shops now remember your last selected item, eliminating the hassle of re-browsing.
Text Font Assignments
Rectified an issue where some in-game texts lacked assigned fonts.
Boss Immunity Fix
Addressed a bug where certain bosses were erroneously immune to damage effects.
Controller/Keyboard Detection Overhaul
Entirely redesigned the controller/keyboard detection for enhanced accuracy and performance.
Event Error Resolution
Fixed the most common 'not found' event errors by implementing a short delay and rechecking.
Spell Casting Corrections
Enemies no longer attempt to cast spells on non-enemy objects.
Noctilium Window Fix
Solved the issue of the Noctilium window disappearing after purchasing an item in the shop.
Shift Key Binding
Added shift key detection for more flexible key binding.
Expanded Key Customization
Introduced additional actions to the keys binding menu for greater customization.
Revamped the main menu for improved compatibility with larger resolutions.
Menu Accessibility
The menu can now be opened even when an 'obtained' message is on the screen.
Completed Hunts Indicator
Differentiated completed hunts with a distinct color in the hunts menu.
Resolution and Menu Adjustments
Updated resolution and adjusted the menu for seamless gameplay in very high resolutions.
Shop Selection Bug Fix
Resolved a bug where the first element of a shop couldn't be selected if the shop closed too quickly.
Default Keyboard Action Bindings Redone
Reimagined default keyboard action bindings for a more intuitive experience.
Menu Navigation Tweaks
Squashed small bugs affecting menu navigation.
Adjustments to improve the gameplay of battles against Krevian and Mother.
Adjusted hitboxes for a more precise combat experience in bosses and standard enemies.
Enemy Life Reduction
Reduced the life of enemies in the first two hunts.
Increased Noctilium Rewards from enemies.
Boss Phase Transition Bug
Fixed a bug causing boss attacks not to stop upon phase transition, potentially leading to Vesper's untimely demise.
Vesper's Invulnerability Tweaks
Increased Vesper's invulnerability time upon respawn after falls or sinking. Added a transparency effect for better visibility.
Noctilium Adjustments
Rebalanced the Noctilium obtained from hunt bosses and certain world enemies.
Visual Polish
Rectified visual errors in various game zones.
Visual Enhancements
Added visual improvements to several game zones.
Attack Movement Distance Reduction
Slightly reduced the distance Vesper covers while attacking.

We have worked hard over the past few months to optimize the overall performance of the game, improving the FPS rate and reducing loading times across all game zones. We have also reduced the game's size on disk by a few GBs.

items.text: Hello Stalkers!
First, let’s talk a bit about the Prime Hunt system, a great challenge for the greatest Stalkers of Medhram!
What are the ‘Prime Hunts’ and how do they work?

There will be a new option available in the main menu: Prime Hunts, which includes bosses, records, and times of the best players. Once selected, you will be able to choose the boss, previously defeated in story mode, that you want to face. These bosses have more health, more damage, and new attack patterns.

After accepting a Prime Hunt in the Main Menu, Vesper will be inside a Lobby, where the player will receive a limited amount of resources to create their own build to face the boss. The boss combat will be timed so the players get to compete in order to achieve the best time mark with their own build of choice. Each record will be registered and published in the game leaderboards.
We are very excited with this update, as Hunt the Night will feature popular bosses from other indie games! Play as Vesper and get ready to hunt creatures that you like from great indie games.
The combat will be challenging and it will adapt both the boss design and music to ‘Hunt the Night’ gameplay style.
The team will be announcing the collabs one after another so you can get sneak peeks of them before release.
Upcoming collaboration will be with Baroque Decay's The Count Lucanor: Red Camerlengo.
To do so we have adapted the combat zone, boss and music to Hunt the Night style: He is a master of fear and can summon dark creatures to hunt Vesper in the abandoned library that is his boss' arena.
Hello, Stalkers!

We have been listening to your invaluable feedback after the release and have worked non-stop to get everything ready. We will be continuously listening to the community, listening to your needs, fixing issues and adding new content!

items.text: Dear Stalkers,

Thanks so much for your feedback and patience! We are currently translating the patch notes into other languages. We will post the full patch details soon, but didn’t want the improvements for the game to be delayed. So, to whet your appetite, we have a short list of what you will find in the patch:
Disappearing mouse cursor fixed.
Steam cloud saves added.
Saving time improved.
Added internal FPS limit to prevent extremely high frame rates.
Fixed an issue that caused player control issues after the second boss.
Translation issues fixed.
Issue with doors that couldn't be entered and with gates that would remain closed fixed.
Boss hit boxes adjusted.
Boss balancing adjustments made, especially to the first and second bosses
And a lot more...
Moonlight Games
Added a new screen suggesting the use of Controller and headphones.
Fixed text display duration during the Game intro, as they were displayed too fast.
General gameplay balancing regarding some rooms and enemies.
Modified the default Mouse+Keyboard controls to make them more intuitive.
Improved the aim system when using Mouse+keyboard controls.
Modified the sprite and effects of the Dark Barriers that appear during several parts of the game, including combat zones and bosses.

The animation and damage of both Hunting Spear and Lacerators have been changed. They were underperforming compared Sword and Greatsword and the hitbox wasn't working as intended. Animations were altered in order to fit the new gameplay style better.

Added a new interaction system. Now a '!' symbol will be displayed when the player is near interactive objects. Furthermore, we improved the collision and interacion zones to make it easier to interact when near them.

Added extra information regarding 'Crow Feathers'. We specified that they are important to solve puzzles too, as we believe this use wasn't clear enough in the previous version. Also, now key words to solve particular puzzles will be displayed in a different color.

Changed the 'Crow Shinre' (Save points) sprite. Sometimes it wasn't visible enough and it is very important regarding gameplay, as it saves your progress and refill your health, bullets and Crimson Roses. Now it will be a predominant asset when placed in an area.
Some of the 'Devourer' and 'Prime Devourer' hitboxes have been modified and adjusted to better suit the animation.
Modified several 'Prime Devourer' animations to make them more visible.
Modified the 'Marauders' (Invisible enemies) location to avoid players losing focus just before starting the Statue's puzzle.
Added and modified several in game sounds.
Fixed an issue regarding HUD player warning when heal was low.
The 'Prime Hunt' lobby display has been changed. Now the chest with the Noctilium is placed near to the vendor, so it is easy to get the currency, buy the items, equip them and fight the boss.
